text: If it is the part of a good general, not only to provide for the present, but also to have a clear foresight of things to come, in this point Pericles is the superior; for he admonished the Athenians, and told them beforehand the ruin the war would bring upon them, by their grasping more than they were able to manage.
author: Plutarch
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
